title: Tamper inspection needs approved triggers and observed acceptance evidence
remediation: The deployment acceptance manager and component custodians identify the items and events that require inspection. For assessed software, verify expected artifact digests and provenance before acceptance and exercise refusal of a harmless changed copy. For assessed physical items, record approved seal and custody checks and their disposition. Use existing release attestations as a supplier input.

milestones.title: Collect an approved inspection procedure, a verified sample, and a recorded refusal or quarantine from a harmless tamper exercise
